title: Rishi Renjen - Evolving Your Investment Process

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: Today's conversation is with Rishi Renjen, the Founder and Chief Investment Officer of ROAM Global Management.
reader_summary.overview: Today's conversation is with Rishi Renjen, the Founder and Chief Investment Officer of ROAM Global Management. Before founding ROAM Global, he was a Managing Director and Sector Head at Maverick Capital, a Partner at TPG-Axon Capital. Rishi earned a Bachelor of Science in Economics, with a concentration in Finance.
